description.text: The third set of the EX series, released on 24 November 2003 with 100 cards, 97 numbered and three secret rares, and two theme decks, FireFang and WindBlast. As its name says, it centers on dragons, which were Colorless Pokémon at the time, and it was the first set to print Colorless as a Weakness; Dragonite ex leads them with 150 HP. The secret rares are tributes to Base Set's Charmander, Charmeleon and Charizard, redrawn by Mitsuhiro Arita.
